list.title: From BUV graduate to Oxford PhD scholar
list.author: Trần Bích Phương
list.description: With steadfast dedication to research, Bích Phương went on to earn her Master’s and PhD in Europe, and today is a postdoctoral researcher at the University of Oxford.

list.title: From a small-town girl to the global stage
list.author: Chu Thị Phương Anh
list.description: Coming from a modest family and being the first to attend university, Phương Anh took a bold turn by striving for a scholarship at an international institution.

list.title: From a remote village to the gate of an International University
list.author: Ốc Thị Quỳnh Anh
list.description: Born in a small mountain village of Nghệ An, Quỳnh Anh endured hardship and loss but kept alive a spark of hope through education.

list.title: From a rejection letter to international research acclaim
list.author: Lý Minh Anh
list.description: A rejection from Cornell did not end Minh Anh’s dream of research. It opened the way for her to continue at the University of Colorado Boulder, where she rose to international stages as a speaker.

list.title: From a shy sheep to a roaring lion
list.author: Đỗ Linh Giang
list.description: Once a timid girl who avoided every gaze, Linh Giang found the courage to step out of her comfort zone.

list.title: From a 'rebellious' student to a resilient young leader
list.author: Nguyễn Ngọc Nhật Anh
list.description: Once labeled a “problem student” with average grades, Nhật Anh transformed through determination and earned a full scholarship at BUV, opening a new chapter of growth.

list.title: Từ nghịch cảnh đến hành trình lan tỏa giá trị cho cộng đồng
list.author: Trịnh Thị Kim Chung
list.description: Gần hai năm trước, khi đang là một người mẹ, một nữ khởi nghiệp và sống trọn vẹn với ước mơ, Kim Chung bất ngờ đối diện với chẩn đoán ung thư giai đoạn cuối.

list.title: Từ nỗ lực vượt sướng đến hành trình khởi nghiệp ở tuổi 18
list.author: Lê Thị Minh Yến
list.description: Minh Yến từng bước “vượt sướng”, từ khởi nghiệp đầu tư chứng khoán khi mới 18 tuổi đến sáng lập học viện đầu tư tài chính Genstock. Mỗi lựa chọn táo bạo đều trở thành chất liệu để Yến xây dựng hành trình bền bỉ và giàu trải nghiệm.

list.title: Từ vòng tay của ông ngoại đến những bước chân bản lĩnh
list.author: Lê Minh Đức
list.description: Sinh ra với bệnh xương thủy tinh, trải qua 40 lần gãy xương và 15 ca phẫu thuật, Minh Đức vẫn kiên cường nuôi giấc mơ học tập. Giành Học bổng Nhà Sáng Lập 2024 của BUV, Đức từng bước vượt qua giới hạn, trở nên tự tin và gắn kết với cộng đồng quốc tế.

list.title: From the will to live to a journey of planting seeds of hope
list.author: Nguyễn Thị Oanh
list.description: Weighing just 900 grams at birth and once abandoned by her own family, Oanh never stopped believing in her value. From the Lionhearted Scholarship to graduating with Distinction, she has turned pain into hope through education and volunteer work.

list.title: From dreams through hospital windows to rebuilding a hometown
list.author: Vi Thanh Nhật
list.description: Born in a Thai ethnic village with a lifelong blood disorder, Thanh Nhật transformed years in hospital wards into motivation to rise and dream of rebuilding his community.

list.title: From the pressure of achievement to self-acceptance
list.author: Phạm Hoàng Minh Khuê
list.description: Under constant pressure to stay on top, Minh Khuê learned to embrace herself, turning struggles into a message that encourages young people to dare to try and to change.

list.title: From self-doubt to a mentor inspiring confidence
list.author: Trần Minh Đức
list.description: Once clouded by self-doubt, Minh Đức grew through leading the Vscholar project, where he passed on opportunities and confidence to others.

list.title: When a woman is educated, an entire generation is transformed
list.author: Bùi Thị Thanh Phương
list.description: Becoming a mother at 18, Thanh Phương once faltered under judgmental eyes. But with love and faith, she found her strength again at BUV, reclaiming her worth and moving forward with confidence.

list.title: From the comfort zone to an international financial analyst
list.author: Nguyễn Gia Khánh
list.description: Switching majors was never an easy choice. Yet Gia Khánh bravely moved from Hospitality Management to Finance, balancing work and study while pursuing the CFA qualification.
